mapper.update: UPDATE platform_access_token SET status = 0, updated_at = NOW() WHERE client_id = #{clientId} AND status = 1
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.client_id, t.token_hash, t.token_prefix, t.status, t.created_at, t.updated_at FROM platform_access_token t INNER JOIN platform_access_client c ON c.id = t.client_id WHERE t.token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND t.status = 1 AND c.status = 1 LIMIT 1

SELECT t.id AS token_id, t.client_id AS client_id, c.client_code AS client_code FROM platform_access_token t INNER JOIN platform_access_client c ON c.id = t.client_id WHERE t.token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND t.status = 1 AND c.status = 1 LIMIT 1
SELECT c.client_code FROM platform_access_token t INNER JOIN platform_access_client c ON c.id = t.client_id WHERE t.id = #{tokenId} LIMIT 1
